categories.note_en: Deciding what a request is, before deciding what to do with it.
categories.note_zh: 先判断这是什么请求，再决定怎么处理。

categories.note_en: Catching bad actions — and bad claims — before they land.
categories.note_zh: 在坏动作（和坏结论）落地前拦住它。

items.reason_en: Scores every tool call before it runs. Small and single-purpose — the right size for a guardrail.
items.reason_zh: 每次工具调用执行前先打分。小而专一——护栏就该是这个体量。

items.reason_en: A tool-call gate that people have actually tested. The most cited starting point in this category.
items.reason_zh: 一个真被人测过的工具调用闸门，是这一类里被引用最多的起点。

items.reason_en: Stops an agent claiming it's done without evidence. Guards against bad **claims**, not bad actions — a failure mode most guardrails ignore.
items.reason_zh: 拦住智能体拿不出证据就说「做完了」。它防的是坏**结论**而不是坏动作——这是大多数护栏都没管的失败模式。

categories.note_en: Deciding what to throw away when the window fills up.
categories.note_zh: 窗口满了，决定丢掉什么。

items.reason_en: A Claude Code plugin that scores every tool call before compaction. Rides an existing user base instead of building one.
items.reason_zh: 一个 Claude Code 插件，压缩前先给每次工具调用打分。它蹭的是现成的用户群，而不是自己攒一个。

categories.note_en: Pieces you plug into an agent loop, not finished apps.
categories.note_zh: 插进智能体回路里的零件，不是成品应用。

items.reason_en: Routing, memory, compaction and skill selection. The most complete example of Jev inside an agent loop rather than bolted on the side.
items.reason_zh: 路由、记忆、压缩、技能选择全都有。是把 Jev 放进智能体回路里（而不是挂在旁边）最完整的一个例子。

categories.note_en: Turning a judgement into a number you can sort by.
categories.note_zh: 把判断变成一个能排序的数字。

categories.note_en: Finished things you can open and use.

items.reason_en: A web agent that replaces the per-step LLM call with a typed decision. **Biggest cost cut in the ecosystem** — every step that used to be a full model call is now one Jev call.
items.reason_zh: 用一次类型化判定替代每一步的 LLM 调用。**生态里最大的一次成本削减**——过去每一步要一次完整模型调用，现在只要一次 Jev 调用。

items.reason_en: A phone-side copilot for WeChat / QQ / X / Feishu. Low enough latency to keep up with a live conversation — that is the whole point of System One here.
items.reason_zh: 手机端的微信 / QQ / X / 飞书副驾。延迟低到能跟上真人对话——这正是 System One 在这里的意义。

items.reason_en: One decision per Monad block. Fast enough to sit inside a block, cheap enough to run every time.
items.reason_zh: 每个 Monad 区块做一次决策。快到能塞进一个区块里，便宜到能每次都跑。

items.reason_en: Computer use. The closest thing here to a general desktop agent.
items.reason_zh: 电脑操作（computer use）。这里最接近通用桌面智能体的一个。

categories.note_en: Getting Jev into the stack you already have.
categories.note_zh: 把 Jev 接进你现有的技术栈。

items.reason_en: 110 use cases you can edit and run in the browser. Zero install — the fastest way to feel the latency difference for yourself.
items.reason_zh: 110 个用例，能直接在浏览器里改和跑。零安装——想亲手感受延迟差异，这是最快的路径。

categories.note_en: Jev pointed at one specific problem.
categories.note_zh: Jev 对准某一个具体问题。
